profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your account and what you may do.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with codes from an authenticator app. Some approval steps require it.
twoFactor.onDescription: Every sign-in asks for a code from your app.
twoFactor.offDescription: Use an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoFactor.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.step2: 2. Or type this key into the app
twoFactor.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code from the app
twoFactor.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please copy it by hand.
twoFactor.codeHint: 6 digits from the app; it changes every 30 seconds.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a code to confirm. Afterwards you cannot approve steps that require 2FA.
twoFactor.reloginDescription: To approve steps that require 2FA, sign in again with a code from the app.
